description: This file defines the ProjectDetailedModel class which provides a detailed representation of a Project entity, including its attributes and associated project administrators. It implements serialization to an array and is used within the API layer for human resource project details.

classes.name: ProjectDetailedModel
classes.description: A model class that serializes a Project entity into a detailed associative array suitable for API responses, including project admin details.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the Project entity into an array, including project administrators with their specific attributes.
